title: Unlocking large scale AI training networks with MRC (Multipath Reliable Connection)
summary: OpenAI introduces MRC (Multipath Reliable Connection), a new supercomputer networking protocol released via OCP to improve resilience and performance in large-scale AI training clusters.
body: OpenAI introduces MRC (Multipath Reliable Connection), a new supercomputer networking protocol released via OCP to improve resilience and performance in large-scale AI training clusters.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式推出MRC（Multipath Reliable Connection）网络协议，并通过OCP（开放计算项目）进行开源。该协议专为大规模AI训练集群设计，旨在解决超大规模计算环境下的网络瓶颈问题，通过多路径传输机制显著提升训练集群的通信性能与系统韧性。此举对于推动超大规模模型训练的硬件基础设施优化具有重要意义。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布了MRC网络协议，旨在提升大规模AI训练集群的性能与稳定性。

glossary.explanationZh: 多路径可靠连接协议，用于优化大规模集群通信。
开放计算项目，旨在分享数据中心硬件设计规范。
用于训练大型AI模型的计算集群系统。
